name: Ethereal Sheer Gown
description: a layered ethereal gown of sheer fabric that flows around her - frosted bright {{PRIMARY}} over a matte underlayer, with delicate {{MAGIC}} glowing fibre-optic threads woven throughout; secured on her shoulders, head uncovered. The fabric is translucent, the thin bikini underlayer visible behind it
notes: Cross-cutting wardrobe piece, reusable by any hero — embeds {{PRIMARY}}/{{ACCENT_SOFT}} so each hero renders in her own palette. Grounded in prompts/_archive/Drakness/final/Drakness_FireRed_Elegant.txt (the fuller, cleaner version of the 'Elegant/Translucent' pattern also found across Drakneta/Drakniya/Draknora's archived final-scene prompts), with the specific colours parameterized instead of hardcoded.
